test_title: PYST 28: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 27 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

I waited for so more years to be with you.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of "**so more**" instead of "**so many**."
 
• The phrase "so more" is grammatically incorrect. The correct phrase should be "**so many**" when referring to countable nouns like **"years."**
 
• Therefore, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I waited** for so many years **to be with you."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1) No error:** This option would be correct if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 3.
 
• **2) years to be:** This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **3) I waited for so more:** This part of the sentence contains the error.
 
• **4) with you:** This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
